description: This file contains unit tests for the RuntimeLocator component, specifically testing the resolve method for different scenarios related to locating and verifying Node.js runtime versions.

classes.name: RuntimeLocatorTests
classes.description: A struct defining unit tests for verifying the behavior of the RuntimeLocator component, including version resolution and error handling scenarios.

methods.name: makeTempExecutable
methods.description: Creates a temporary executable file with specified contents for testing purposes.

methods.name: resolve succeeds with valid node
methods.description: Tests that RuntimeLocator.resolve correctly identifies a valid Node.js version.

methods.name: resolve fails on boundary below minimum
methods.description: Tests that RuntimeLocator.resolve appropriately fails when Node.js version is below the minimum supported.

methods.name: resolve fails when too old
methods.description: Checks that resolution fails for an outdated Node.js version.

methods.name: resolve fails when version unparsable
methods.description: Ensures that an unparsable version string results in an appropriate error.

methods.name: describe failure includes paths
methods.description: Verifies that failure messages include search paths and relevant version info.

methods.name: runtime version parses with leading V and metadata
methods.description: Tests the parsing of Node.js version strings with variations like 'v' prefix or additional metadata.
